s0201.literal: On jiazi day Mangudai, Badu, and Baijanu were separately dispatched to lead the Imperial Guard south on campaign.
s0201.idiomatic: On jiazi day Mangudai, Badu, and Baijanu were separately dispatched to lead the Imperial Guard south on campaign.

s0202.literal: On bingyin day Qara Qasun was made Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat, Cui Bin Associate Administrator, who was also to conduct Henan Circuit pacification commissioner affairs.
s0202.idiomatic: On bingyin day Qara Qasun was made left chancellor of the Central Secretariat and Cui Bin associate administrator, who was also to conduct Henan Circuit pacification commissioner affairs.

s0203.literal: An edict ordered the responsible offices to review and verify Yan'an's newly levied troops and exempt those too poor to serve.
s0203.idiomatic: An edict ordered the responsible offices to review Yan'an's newly levied troops and exempt those too poor to serve.

s0204.literal: On wuchen day an investigating censor said: "The Jiang-Huai region has not yet submitted, and commanders are lacking.
s0204.idiomatic: On wuchen day an investigating censor said: "The Jiang-Huai region has not yet submitted, and commanders are lacking.

s0205.literal: Now Ariq Haiya's son Husu Haiya and Liu Zheng's son Gai have been put in chief command—they know nothing of warfare and lack public esteem; they should be removed according to the precedent for younger brothers and sons."
s0205.idiomatic: Now Ariq Haiya's son Husu Haiya and Liu Zheng's son Gai have been put in chief command—they know nothing of warfare and lack public esteem; they should be removed according to the precedent for younger brothers and sons."

s0207.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the yihai new moon, an edict ordered Shanbei Liaodong Circuit's surveillance and investigation commissioner Urus Buqa, together with Associate Administrator Lian Xixian, to conduct provincial affairs at the Northern Capital; King Touliangge was not to handle affairs—on major matters Xixian and the others were to consult with him.
s0207.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the yihai new moon, an edict ordered Shanbei Liaodong Circuit's surveillance commissioner Urus Buqa, together with associate administrator Lian Xixian, to conduct provincial affairs at the Northern Capital; King Touliangge was not to handle affairs, and on major matters Xixian and the others were to consult with him.

s0208.literal: On yiyou day eighty-one soldiers holding life-servitude certificates were transferred to garrison farming at Karakorum.
s0208.idiomatic: On yiyou day eighty-one soldiers holding life-servitude certificates were transferred to garrison farming at Karakorum.

s0209.literal: On guisi day King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo died; envoys brought his final memorial and stated that Crown Prince Chŏm was filial and careful and could be entrusted with affairs of succession.
s0209.idiomatic: On guisi day King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo died; envoys brought his final memorial and stated that Crown Prince Chŏm was filial and careful and could be entrusted with succession.

s0210.literal: An edict ordered Zhang Huan, associate director of the Shangdu garrison commission, to enfeoff Chŏm as King of Goryeo.
s0210.idiomatic: An edict ordered Zhang Huan, associate director of the Shangdu garrison commission, to invest Chŏm as king of Goryeo.

s0211.literal: On yiwei day Bayan and the others took leave at court; the Emperor told them: "Of those in antiquity who took Jiangnan well, Cao Bin alone did so.
s0211.idiomatic: On yiwei day Bayan and the others took leave at court; the Emperor told them: "Of those in antiquity who took Jiangnan well, Cao Bin alone did so.

s0212.literal: If you can refrain from killing, you will be my Cao Bin."
s0212.idiomatic: If you can refrain from killing, you will be my Cao Bin."

s0213.literal: In Xingyuan's Feng Prefecture the people presented wheat stalks with four to seven ears per stem, and grain stalks with three ears.
s0213.idiomatic: In Xingyuan's Feng Prefecture the people presented wheat stalks with four to seven ears per stem and grain stalks with three ears.

s0214.literal: In the eighth month, on the jiachen new moon, regulations for establishing altars and enclosures for state and earth worship were issued to all routes.
s0214.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiachen new moon, regulations for establishing state and earth altars and enclosures were issued to all routes.

s0215.literal: On dingwei day Shi Tianze said: "Now that the great army is on the march, separate branch secretariats have been placed in Jinghu and Huai-xi; since their rank and position are not subordinate to one another, orders cannot be unified—and this will later cause failure."
s0215.idiomatic: On dingwei day Shi Tianze said: "Now that the great army is on the march, separate branch secretariats have been placed in Jinghu and Huai-xi; since their rank and position are not subordinate to one another, orders cannot be unified—and this will later cause failure."

s0216.literal: The Emperor agreed and restored the Huai-xi Branch Secretariat as a branch privy council.
s0216.idiomatic: The Emperor agreed and restored the Huai-xi branch secretariat as a branch privy council.

s0217.literal: On guichou day the Branch Secretariat said: "For prefectures along the Jiang and Han not yet taken, please have Lü Wenhuan lead his followers before the walls to persuade them, so they will know our leniency and good treatment of surrendered generals—this too is a sound policy."
s0217.idiomatic: On guichou day the branch secretariat said: "For prefectures along the Jiang and Han not yet taken, please have Lü Wenhuan lead his followers before the walls to persuade them, so they will know our leniency and good treatment of surrendered generals—this too is a sound policy."

s0219.literal: On jiayin day the ban on weapons in Henan was lifted.
s0219.idiomatic: On jiayin day the ban on weapons in Henan was lifted.

s0220.literal: On xinwei day King Chŏm of Goryeo sent his chief privy secretary Pak Yu to congratulate the Emperor's birthday.
s0220.idiomatic: On xinwei day King Chŏm of Goryeo sent his chief privy secretary Pak Yu to congratulate the Emperor's birthday.

s0221.literal: An edict stated that newly enrolled troops from Taiyuan garrisoned far in the two Chuan were truly deserving of sympathy; the Privy Council was told to dispatch envoys to requisition grain stores and provide for their families.
s0221.idiomatic: An edict stated that newly enrolled troops from Taiyuan garrisoned far in the two Chuan were truly deserving of sympathy; the Privy Council was told to dispatch envoys to requisition grain stores and provide for their families.

s0222.literal: On the ninth month, bingxu day, the Branch Secretariat reported that the great army had departed Xiangyang and issued proclamations to Song prefectural officials, garrison commanders, and the populace.
s0222.idiomatic: On bingxu day of the ninth month the branch secretariat reported that the great army had departed Xiangyang and issued proclamations to Song prefectural officials, garrison commanders, and the populace.

s0223.literal: On guisi day the army halted at Yanshan, twenty li from Ying Prefecture.
s0223.idiomatic: On guisi day the army halted at Yanshan, twenty li from Ying Prefecture.

s0224.literal: More than a hundred thousand Song troops held Ying, flanking the Han River; they walled Wansheng Fort, deployed a thousand warships on both banks, stretched iron chains across the river through dozens of large vessels, and blocked our fleet from descending.
s0224.idiomatic: More than a hundred thousand Song troops held Ying, flanking the Han River; they walled Wansheng Fort, deployed a thousand warships on both banks, stretched iron chains across the river through dozens of large vessels, and blocked the Yuan fleet from descending.

s0225.literal: Only at Huangjiawan was there a stream passing through Yaozi Mountain into Tang Harbor and reaching the Yangzi; the Song also built a dam there, walled a fort, garrisoned troops, and moored hundreds of boats tied to the dam.
s0225.idiomatic: Only at Huangjiawan was there a stream passing through Yaozi Mountain into Tang Harbor and reaching the Yangzi; the Song also built a dam there, walled a fort, garrisoned troops, and moored hundreds of boats tied to the dam.

s0226.literal: Bayan directed the armies to storm and capture it, broke through the dam, hauled boats into the stream, emerged at Tang Harbor, and advanced in formation.
s0226.idiomatic: Bayan directed the armies to storm and capture it, broke through the dam, hauled boats into the stream, emerged at Tang Harbor, and advanced in formation.

s0227.literal: The imperial procession returned from Shangdu.
s0227.idiomatic: The imperial procession returned from Shangdu.

s0228.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jiyou day, an offering was made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0228.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on jiyou day, an offering was made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0229.literal: On gengshen day the Changhexi wanhu Bila Chong plundered armor and weapons and gathered a crowd in rebellion; Huoniu Chi had moved garrisons and not yet returned, so Deputy Marshal Tan Ching led subordinate officials to the scene.
s0229.idiomatic: On gengshen day the Changhexi wanhu Bila Chong plundered armor and weapons and gathered a crowd in rebellion; Huoniu Chi had moved garrisons and not yet returned, so deputy marshal Tan Ching led subordinate officials to the scene.

s0230.literal: The Emperor said: "Ching need not go alone—hurry three thousand additional troops to Huoniu Chi and join forces to suppress them."
s0230.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "Ching need not go alone—hurry three thousand additional troops to Huoniu Chi and join forces to suppress them."

s0231.literal: On renxu day Jupiter infringed upon the Wall and Screen constellation.
s0231.idiomatic: On renxu day Jupiter infringed upon the Wall and Screen constellation.

s0232.literal: On yichou day Bayan directed the generals to capture Shayang Fort and took the defending commander Chuan Louwang alive.
s0232.idiomatic: On yichou day Bayan directed the generals to capture Shayang Fort and took the defending commander Chuan Louwang alive.

s0233.literal: The next day they reached Xincheng; the zongzhi Huang Shun lowered himself from the wall to surrender.
s0233.idiomatic: The next day they reached Xincheng; the zongzhi Huang Shun lowered himself from the wall to surrender.

s0234.literal: Bayan sent Shun to summon the commander Bian Juyi, who refused to come out; zongguan Li Ting stormed the outer fort, the armies swarmed up the walls and took it, and Juyi burned himself to death.
s0234.idiomatic: Bayan sent Shun to summon the commander Bian Juyi, who refused to come out; zongguan Li Ting stormed the outer fort, the armies swarmed up the walls and took it, and Juyi burned himself to death.

s0235.literal: On xinwei day the Prince of Beiping Nanhumai was granted thirty thousand cattle and a hundred thousand sheep.
s0235.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Prince of Beiping Nanhumai was granted thirty thousand cattle and a hundred thousand sheep.

s0236.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengchen day, thirty-nine men were executed for capital crimes.
s0236.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengchen day, thirty-nine men were executed for capital crimes.

s0237.literal: On renwu day an edict ordered the Sichuan Branch Privy Council under Yesudai'er to take Jiading Prefecture.
s0237.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict ordered the Sichuan branch privy council under Yesudai'er to take Jiading Prefecture.

s0238.literal: On guiwei day the seal keeper Dong Wenzhong said: "I have lately heard that sorcerers have appeared one after another in Yidu and Zhangde; since the surveillance commissioners, darughachi, and village heads could not stop them, they should be punished by joint responsibility."
s0238.idiomatic: On guiwei day the seal keeper Dong Wenzhong said: "I have lately heard that sorcerers have appeared one after another in Yidu and Zhangde; since the surveillance commissioners, darughachi, and village heads could not stop them, they should be punished by joint responsibility."

s0239.literal: An edict ordered this carried out.
s0239.idiomatic: An edict ordered this carried out.

s0240.literal: On yiyou day the army halted at Fuzhou; Song pacification commissioner Zhai Gui came out to surrender.
s0240.idiomatic: On yiyou day the army halted at Fuzhou; Song pacification commissioner Zhai Gui came out to surrender.

s0241.literal: On dinghai day an edict declared that Song Jiading pacification commissioner Zan Wanshou and all garrison commanders who surrendered would, along with those fleeing punishment or deserting their lords, all be pardoned according to the original terms.
s0241.idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict declared that Song Jiading pacification commissioner Zan Wanshou and all garrison commanders who surrendered would, along with those fleeing punishment or deserting their lords, all be pardoned according to the original terms.

s0242.literal: On guisi day Eastern Route Marshal Yang Wen'an joined Mongol wanhu Qeljenai and Yisibeli at Dazhou, marched straight on Yun'an, met Song troops at Mahu River and routed them, then took the forts of Yun'an, Luogong, and Gaoyang; Yang Wen'an and others were rewarded with graded gifts of gold and silver.
s0242.idiomatic: On guisi day Eastern Route marshal Yang Wen'an joined Mongol wanhu Qeljenai and Yisibeli at Dazhou, marched straight on Yun'an, met Song troops at Mahu River and routed them, then took the forts of Yun'an, Luogong, and Gaoyang; Yang Wen'an and others were rewarded with graded gifts of gold and silver.

s0243.literal: A thousand qing of wasteland in Xianghe was set aside for Zhongwei garrison farming.
s0243.idiomatic: A thousand qing of wasteland in Xianghe was set aside for Zhongwei garrison farming.

s0244.literal: Bayan sent wanhu Temür and interpreter Ali to report the victories at Shayang and Xincheng and to bring the Xincheng zongzhi Huang Shun for audience; Shun was granted gold, brocade robes, and fine armor, appointed Hu-bei Circuit pacification commissioner, and given a tiger tally.
s0244.idiomatic: Bayan sent wanhu Temür and interpreter Ali to report the victories at Shayang and Xincheng and to bring the Xincheng zongzhi Huang Shun for audience; Shun was granted gold, brocade robes, and fine armor, appointed Hu-bei Circuit pacification commissioner, and given a tiger tally.

s0245.literal: An edict stated: "Thieves and swindlers in the capital are numerous; severe punishments should be firmly established."
s0245.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Thieves and swindlers in the capital are numerous; severe punishments should be firmly established."

s0246.literal: Those who had campaigned against Japan—Hudun, Huqa, Liu Fuheng, and Sanmuhe—were summoned to court.
s0246.idiomatic: Those who had campaigned against Japan—Hudun, Huqa, Liu Fuheng, and Sanmuhe—were summoned to court.

s0247.literal: On renyin day Antong, citing Ahmad's usurpation of fiscal authority harming state and people and the misuse of subordinates, asked for separate selection of personnel;
s0247.idiomatic: On renyin day Antong, citing Ahmad's usurpation of fiscal authority harming state and people and the misuse of subordinates, asked for separate selection of personnel;

s0248.literal: his palace construction, in which connections were used for fraud, should also be investigated.
s0248.idiomatic: he also asked that Ahmad's palace construction, in which connections were used for fraud, be investigated.

s0249.literal: The Emperor ordered a thorough prosecution.
s0249.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered a thorough prosecution.

s0250.literal: Construction was begun on the Direct Audience Hall south of the pavilion and on the eastern and western halls; eight hundred musicians were additionally selected and assigned to the Court of Musical Entertainments.
s0250.idiomatic: Construction was begun on the Direct Audience Hall south of the pavilion and on the eastern and western halls; eight hundred musicians were additionally selected and assigned to the Court of Musical Entertainments.

s0251.literal: In the twelfth month, on bingwu day, Bayan's great army halted at Hankou.
s0251.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingwu day, Bayan's great army halted at Hankou.

s0252.literal: Song Huai-xi commissioner Xia Gui, commanders-in-chief Gao Wenming and Liu Yi, with ten thousand warships held the passes; Wang Da defended Yangluo Fort and Jinghu pacification commissioner Zhu Yisun's mobile force blocked midstream, so the army could not advance.
s0252.idiomatic: Song Huai-xi commissioner Xia Gui, commanders-in-chief Gao Wenming and Liu Yi, with ten thousand warships held the passes; Wang Da defended Yangluo Fort and Jinghu pacification commissioner Zhu Yisun's mobile force blocked midstream, so the army could not advance.

s0253.literal: Following wanhu Ma Fu's advice, they opened the dam at Hankou, brought boats through to Lunhe Mouth, struck straight for Shawan, and entered the Great River.
s0253.idiomatic: Following wanhu Ma Fu's advice, they opened the dam at Hankou, brought boats through to Lunhe Mouth, struck straight for Shawan, and entered the Great River.

s0254.literal: On guichou day two thousand masterless fugitive slaves from various routes were assigned to the Branch Works Department.
s0254.idiomatic: On guichou day two thousand masterless fugitive slaves from various routes were assigned to the branch works department.

s0255.literal: On jiayin day Xindu and others were rewarded for the campaign against Tamna with graded paper money and silk.
s0255.idiomatic: On jiayin day Xindu and others were rewarded for the campaign against Tamna with graded paper money and silk.

s0256.literal: On yimao day Ariq Haiya directed wanhu Zhang Hongfan and others to attack Wuji Fort; Song Xia Gui came with troops to relieve it; Aju led wanhu Yan Che'er and four wing armies to moor at Qingshanji.
s0256.idiomatic: On yimao day Ariq Haiya directed wanhu Zhang Hongfan and others to attack Wuji Fort; Song Xia Gui came with troops to relieve it; Aju led wanhu Yan Che'er and four wing armies to moor at Qingshanji.

s0257.literal: On bingchen day wanhu Shi Ge crossed first with one army but was beaten by Song Jing-E commander Cheng Pengfei; zongguan Shi Talahun and others led troops to the enemy and Pengfei was routed and fled.
s0257.idiomatic: On bingchen day wanhu Shi Ge crossed first with one army but was beaten by Song Jing-E commander Cheng Pengfei; zongguan Shi Talahun and others led troops to the enemy and Pengfei was routed and fled.

s0258.literal: The army advanced to Shazhou, reached Guanyin Mountain; Xia Gui fled east; Wuji Fort was taken and Song commander Wang Da was beheaded; they first reached the south bank and pursued to the south gate of E Prefecture before returning.
s0258.idiomatic: The army advanced to Shazhou and reached Guanyin Mountain; Xia Gui fled east; Wuji Fort was taken and Song commander Wang Da was beheaded; they first reached the south bank and pursued to the south gate of E Prefecture before returning.

s0259.literal: On dingsi day Bayan climbed Wuji Mountain; Zhu Yisun fled back to Jiangling.
s0259.idiomatic: On dingsi day Bayan climbed Wuji Mountain; Zhu Yisun fled back to Jiangling.

s0260.literal: On jiwei day the army halted at E Prefecture; Song Registrar of the Secretariat and Hu-bei intendant Zhang Yannan, acting military prefect of Hanyang Wang Yi, and prefect of De'an Lai Xingguo all surrendered their cities; Cheng Pengfei surrendered with his army.
s0260.idiomatic: On jiwei day the army halted at E Prefecture; Song registrar of the Secretariat and Hu-bei intendant Zhang Yannan, acting military prefect of Hanyang Wang Yi, and prefect of De'an Lai Xingguo all surrendered their cities; Cheng Pengfei surrendered with his army.

s0261.literal: Bayan, acting on imperial commission, appointed Song E Prefecture militia zongzhi Wang Gai to administer E Prefecture, kept Wang Yi and Lai Xingguo in their former posts, withdrew garrison troops, and reassigned them among the armies.
s0261.idiomatic: Bayan, acting on imperial commission, appointed Song E Prefecture militia zongzhi Wang Gai to administer E Prefecture, kept Wang Yi and Lai Xingguo in their former posts, withdrew garrison troops, and reassigned them among the armies.

s0262.literal: Orders forbade plunder; all fugitive civilians were released to return home.
s0262.idiomatic: Orders forbade plunder; all fugitive civilians were released to return home.

s0263.literal: Ariq Haiya's forty thousand troops were left to guard E and Han.
s0263.idiomatic: Ariq Haiya's forty thousand troops were left to guard E and Han.

s0264.literal: Bayan and Aju led the great army down by land and water; Commander of the Imperial Guard Tumen was rear guard for all armies.
s0264.idiomatic: Bayan and Aju led the great army down by land and water; commander of the Imperial Guard Tumen was rear guard for all armies.

s0265.literal: Xiangyang Route zongguan Jia Juzhen was made pacification commissioner and charged with branch secretariat affairs.
s0265.idiomatic: Xiangyang Route zongguan Jia Juzhen was made pacification commissioner and charged with branch secretariat affairs.

s0266.literal: On gengshen day a fire at Zhengyang in Huai-xi burned buildings, armor, and weapons without remainder; wanhu Aisan Buqa and others were beaten in varying degrees.
s0266.idiomatic: On gengshen day a fire at Zhengyang in Huai-xi burned buildings, armor, and weapons without remainder; wanhu Aisan Buqa and others were beaten in varying degrees.

s0267.literal: On guihai day the Perfect Sovereign of the Grand One Li Jusu was granted one residence, with the plaque reading Palace of Grand One, Broad Blessing, and Ten Thousand Longevity.
s0267.idiomatic: On guihai day the Perfect Sovereign of the Grand One Li Jusu was granted one residence, with the plaque reading Palace of Grand One, Broad Blessing, and Ten Thousand Longevity.

s0268.literal: The Branch Secretariat reported the victory in crossing the Yangzi.
s0268.idiomatic: The branch secretariat reported the victory in crossing the Yangzi.

s0269.literal: An edict released Lü Wenhuan and all troops under his office to return home.
s0269.idiomatic: An edict released Lü Wenhuan and all troops under his office to return home.

s0270.literal: Nanyang's Lushi County was transferred to Song Prefecture; Guidede's Yongcheng County was established; Changwu County was abolished into Jingchuan; Liangyuan County was abolished into Lingtai.
s0270.idiomatic: Nanyang's Lushi County was transferred to Song Prefecture; Guidede's Yongcheng County was established; Changwu County was abolished into Jingchuan; Liangyuan County was abolished into Lingtai.

s0272.literal: Locust and similar insect disasters occurred at nine places; where the people were hungry, 75,415 shi of rice and 40,599 shi of millet were issued for relief.
s0272.idiomatic: Locust and similar insect disasters occurred at nine places; where the people were hungry, 75,415 shi of rice and 40,599 shi of millet were issued for relief.

s0273.literal: In the twelfth year, spring, first month, on the guiyou new moon, King Chŏm of Goryeo sent his deputy director Li Sintae to congratulate and present the annual tribute.
s0273.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, on the guiyou new moon of the first month of spring, King Chŏm of Goryeo sent his deputy director Li Sintae to congratulate and present the annual tribute.

s0274.literal: On jiaxu day the great army halted at Huang Prefecture; Song deputy commissioner for river defense and Huang prefect Chen Yi surrendered the city; Bayan, acting on commission, appointed Yi Grand Commander of the River Coast.
s0274.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the great army halted at Huang Prefecture; Song deputy commissioner for river defense and Huang prefect Chen Yi surrendered the city; Bayan, acting on commission, appointed Yi grand commander of the river coast.

s0275.literal: His son Yan was prefect of Lian Prefecture; Yi sent men with a letter to persuade him, and when it arrived Yan surrendered.
s0275.idiomatic: His son Yan was prefect of Lian Prefecture; Yi sent men with a letter to persuade him, and when it arrived Yan surrendered.

s0276.literal: On yihai day seven hundred new settlers from Xiangyang were moved to Hebei.
s0276.idiomatic: On yihai day seven hundred new settlers from Xiangyang were moved to Hebei.

s0277.literal: Eastern Route deputy marshal Zhang Derun took Li Yi City, killed Song pacification commissioner Zhang Zi, and won over more than 1,500 soldiers and civilians.
s0277.idiomatic: Eastern Route deputy marshal Zhang Derun took Li Yi City, killed Song pacification commissioner Zhang Zi, and won over more than 1,500 soldiers and civilians.

s0278.literal: Then Marshal Zhang Guisun was sent to seize territory and captured zongguan Guo Wu and commander Tang Hui along with five others.
s0278.idiomatic: Then marshal Zhang Guisun was sent to seize territory and captured zongguan Guo Wu and commander Tang Hui along with five others.

s0279.literal: Derun was granted fifty taels of gold, western brocade, a gold saddle, fine armor, and a bow with arrows; officers and soldiers under him received three hundred ingots of paper money.
s0279.idiomatic: Derun was granted fifty taels of gold, western brocade, a gold saddle, fine armor, and a bow with arrows; officers and soldiers under him received three hundred ingots of paper money.

s0280.literal: On wuyin day Liu Zheng died.
s0280.idiomatic: On wuyin day Liu Zheng died.

s0281.literal: The Anxi Wang's chancellery requested ten thousand ingots for military needs; an edict granted one thousand.
s0281.idiomatic: The Anxi Wang's chancellery requested ten thousand ingots for military needs; an edict granted one thousand.

s0282.literal: On guiwei day the army halted at Qi Prefecture; Song pacification commissioner Guan Jingmo surrendered the city.
s0282.idiomatic: On guiwei day the army halted at Qi Prefecture; Song pacification commissioner Guan Jingmo surrendered the city.

s0283.literal: On yiyou day the Privy Council was ordered to place the garrison armies under Naghachar and Yesudai'er and eight hundred newly levied strong men from Deng and Lai under the Five Prefectures Military Commission; Tancheng and Shizilu were also placed under the commission's command.
s0283.idiomatic: On yiyou day the Privy Council was ordered to place the garrison armies under Naghachar and Yesudai'er and eight hundred newly levied strong men from Deng and Lai under the Five Prefectures Military Commission; Tancheng and Shizilu were also placed under the commission's command.

s0284.literal: On bingxu day the great army halted at Jiang Prefecture; Song Xi'an pacification commissioner and Jiang prefect Qian Zhensun and Huai-xi Lu'an Army's Cao Ming surrendered their cities.
s0284.idiomatic: On bingxu day the great army halted at Jiang Prefecture; Song Xi'an pacification commissioner and Jiang prefect Qian Zhensun and Huai-xi Lu'an Army's Cao Ming surrendered their cities.

s0285.literal: On dinghai day privy councillors said: "Song frontier prefectures such as Jiading, Chongqing, Jiangling, Ying Prefecture, and Lianhai all hold out with arms; imperial letters should be sent to summon them."
s0285.idiomatic: On dinghai day privy councillors said: "Song frontier prefectures such as Jiading, Chongqing, Jiangling, Ying Prefecture, and Lianhai all hold out with arms; imperial letters should be sent to summon them."

s0287.literal: Song prefect of Nankang Ye Chang surrendered the city.
s0287.idiomatic: Song prefect of Nankang Ye Chang surrendered the city.

s0288.literal: An edict ordered Imperial Guard commander Jadish and Nangadai to lead two thousand Mongol troops, and Baijanu, Tanggu, and Manggudai to lead ten thousand Han troops to Cai Prefecture;
s0288.idiomatic: An edict ordered Imperial Guard commander Jadish and Nangadai to lead two thousand Mongol troops, and Baijanu, Tanggu, and Manggudai to lead ten thousand Han troops to Cai Prefecture;

s0289.literal: Tumen and Jia Manggudai were again to lead the remaining troops to court.
s0289.idiomatic: Tumen and Jia Manggudai were again to lead the remaining troops to court.

s0290.literal: On jichou day Boshu and Tang Yongjian were sent bearing an edict to summon Ying Prefecture; the Xiangyang military commission was also ordered to assign three thousand troops to escort Yongjian and the others.
s0290.idiomatic: On jichou day Boshu and Tang Yongjian were sent bearing an edict to summon Ying Prefecture; the Xiangyang military commission was also ordered to assign three thousand troops to escort Yongjian and the others.

s0291.literal: Fourteen Mongols, Uighurs, and Han were selected to go to the Branch Secretariat as civilian officials for newly submitted prefectures and districts.
s0291.idiomatic: Fourteen Mongols, Uighurs, and Han were selected to go to the branch secretariat as civilian officials for newly submitted prefectures and districts.

s0292.literal: On gengyin day Deputy Commander of the Right Guard Zheng Wen, Tanggu, and Temür were ordered to lead ten thousand guard troops together with Jadish and Nangadai to garrison Huang Prefecture.
s0292.idiomatic: On gengyin day deputy commander of the Right Guard Zheng Wen, Tanggu, and Temür were ordered to lead ten thousand guard troops together with Jadish and Nangadai to garrison Huang Prefecture.

s0293.literal: An edict summoned the Chongqing prefectural commission and all subordinate prefectures, districts, fortresses, officials, soldiers, and civilians to surrender the cities.
s0293.idiomatic: An edict summoned the Chongqing prefectural commission and all subordinate prefectures, districts, fortresses, officials, soldiers, and civilians to surrender the cities.

s0294.literal: On renchen day Pacification Commissioner Jia Juzhen was made concurrently secretary of the Branch Secretariat and garrisoned at E Prefecture.
s0294.idiomatic: On renchen day pacification commissioner Jia Juzhen was made concurrently secretary of the branch secretariat and garrisoned at E Prefecture.

s0295.literal: Annan envoys returned; an edict instructed them on the old regulations for household registers, darughachi, troop levies, relay stations, rents, and annual tribute.
s0295.idiomatic: Annan envoys returned; an edict instructed them on the old regulations for household registers, darughachi, troop levies, relay stations, rents, and annual tribute.

s0296.literal: On yimao day Minister of War Lian Xixian, Vice Minister of Works Yan Zhongfan, and Secretariat Director Chai Zizhi were sent bearing the state letter as envoys to Song.
s0296.idiomatic: On yimao day minister of war Lian Xixian, vice minister of works Yan Zhongfan, and secretariat director Chai Zizhi were sent bearing the state letter as envoys to Song.

s0297.literal: On dingyou day ten thousand men enlisted by Wanjia Nu who volunteered for service were sent south on campaign.
s0297.idiomatic: On dingyou day ten thousand men enlisted by Wanjia Nu who volunteered for service were sent south on campaign.

s0298.literal: On jihai day Yunnan zongguan Xin Juri, Shi Mai, and others killed Heychar Sheliwei, who had raised rebellion; they were rewarded with gold.
s0298.idiomatic: On jihai day Yunnan zongguan Xin Juri, Shi Mai, and others killed Heychar Sheliwei, who had raised rebellion; they were rewarded with gold.

s0299.literal: Turu was ordered to Yunnan to hurry Aruq Temür to come to court.
s0299.idiomatic: Turu was ordered to Yunnan to hurry Aruq Temür to come to court.

s0300.literal: Because many barbarian peoples had not yet submitted, pacification commissions were also to conduct marshal's headquarters affairs under branch secretariat command, set up prefectures and counties, and appoint magistrates selected for integrity and ability.
s0300.idiomatic: Because many barbarian peoples had not yet submitted, pacification commissions were also to conduct marshal's headquarters affairs under branch secretariat command, set up prefectures and counties, and appoint magistrates selected for integrity and ability.
